title: How to handle a rude caller
content: Stay calm. Lower your voice slightly. Say 'I want to help, but I need you to speak to me calmly.' Document the call. Then go take 5 minutes to breathe.

title: Spotting scam emails
content: Check the sender address carefully. Look for urgency, bad grammar, and requests for passwords or payments. When in doubt, delete and report.

title: Remote work burnout
content: Set a hard stop time. Create a 'commute' — walk around the block before and after work. Schedule at least one call with a colleague weekly just to talk, not work.

title: Feeling invisible in the office
content: Send a weekly 'invisible cost' email listing what you handled that no one saw. Not bragging — just documentation. Managers respond to data.

title: Hybrid promotion gap
content: Schedule a monthly visibility chat with your manager. Ask directly: 'What would promotion look like for me in this setup?' Get it in writing.
